title_zh: Stage 69：UCP OpenRPC 鉴权/折扣预览/SPT、ACP Feed/履约优先/同意、AP2 HNP/受托熔断器与 tau2 语音金额/成对匹配 16 场景基准报告
title_en: Stage 69: UCP OpenRPC Auth/Discount/SPT, ACP Feed/Consent/Razorpay, AP2 HNP/FCB & tau2 Spoken Amount/Paired Match 16-Scenario Benchmark

scenarios.question_zh: OpenRPC ec.auth/ep.cart.auth type 必填、get_product 仅返回 discounts.available[]、SPT 不透明令牌、含税价格及 event_feed 全合规时是否自动放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should compliant OpenRPC auth type, get_product discounts.available[], opaque SPT, tax inclusion, and event_feed pass automatically?

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #715 get_product 非法返回 discounts.applied[] 拦截
scenarios.question_zh: 目录查询 get_product 在无购物车上下文时返回 discounts.applied[]，护栏是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: When catalog get_product returns discounts.applied[] without cart context, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 拦截无购物车上下文的 discounts.applied[]，防止目录页缓存虚假已减免价格。
scenarios.detail_en: Blocks discounts.applied[] on get_product where only discounts.available[] previews are legal.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #713 shared_payment_token 原始 PAN/CVC 泄露拦截
scenarios.title_en: UCP #713 shared_payment_token Raw PAN/CVC Leak Block
scenarios.question_zh: dev.ucp.payment.shared_payment_token 载荷夹带明文 PAN 4111... 时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: When dev.ucp.payment.shared_payment_token leaks raw PAN 4111..., is checkout blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 拦截在 SPT 句柄中夹带明文卡号/CVC 的严重凭证泄露。
scenarios.detail_en: Blocks raw PAN/CVC fields inside dev.ucp.payment.shared_payment_token payloads.

scenarios.title_zh: UCP #691/#669 含税价格重复计税与空 actions/applies_to 拦截
scenarios.title_en: UCP #691/#669 Tax-Inclusive Double-Tax & Empty Actions Block
scenarios.question_zh: price_treatment.tax.inclusion='included' 却额外加收 800 分税费且 actions={} 为空时是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: When tax.inclusion='included' adds extra tax and actions={} is empty, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 阻断含税商品重复加税（10000+800）以及违反 minProperties/minItems 的空对象。
scenarios.detail_en: Prevents double-taxation on tax-inclusive items and enforces minProperties:1 / minItems:1.

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #255/#201/#200/#199/#215 Feed/履约优先/同意/Razorpay 基线
scenarios.question_zh: UpsertProductsResponse 严格契约、suggested_price feed_id 溯源、履约先于扣款及 in.razorpay.upi 合规时是否自动放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should compliant UpsertProductsResponse, suggested_price provenance, fulfillment-before-payment, and Razorpay UPI pass?

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #255/#201 Upsert 额外字段与无溯源 suggested_price 拦截
scenarios.title_en: ACP #255/#201 Upsert Extra Field & Unprovenanced Suggested Price Block
scenarios.question_zh: UpsertProductsResponse 含未声明 internal_debug 字段且 suggested_price 缺失 feed_id 时是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: When UpsertProductsResponse has extra fields and suggested_price lacks feed_id, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 强制执行 UpsertProductsResponse additionalProperties:false 与 PriceSource.feed_id 溯源。
scenarios.detail_en: Enforces UpsertProductsResponse additionalProperties:false and PriceSource.feed_id provenance.

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #200 结账完成请求先扣款后应用 fulfillment_details 拦截
scenarios.title_en: ACP #200 Payment Before fulfillment_details Order Violation Block
scenarios.question_zh: CheckoutSessionCompleteRequest 在应用 fulfillment_details 之前先执行 payment_processed，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: When CheckoutSessionCompleteRequest runs payment_processed before fulfillment_details_applied, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 拦截先扣款后更新地址/运费的时序倒置漏洞（ACP PR #200）。
scenarios.detail_en: Blocks out-of-order completion where payment runs before fulfillment_details (ACP PR #200).

scenarios.title_zh: ACP #199 非 HTTPS 隐私链接与未声明营销渠道同意拦截
scenarios.title_en: ACP #199 Non-HTTPS Privacy URL & Undeclared Consent Channel Block
scenarios.question_zh: marketing_consent_options 使用 http:// 隐私链接且提交未声明的 sms 同意时是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: When marketing_consent_options uses http:// privacy URL and submits undeclared sms consent, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 拦截非 HTTPS 隐私政策 URL 与越权写入未展示营销渠道同意。
scenarios.detail_en: Rejects non-HTTPS privacy_policy_url and marketing_consents for channels absent from options.

scenarios.title_en: AP2 #191/#198/#202/#187/#139 HNP Binding & Closed FCB Baseline
scenarios.question_zh: DOMString 金额、预算内支出、human_not_present 意图哈希绑定、FCB CLOSED 及三段式 UPI Collect 合规时是否自动放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should DOMString amount, in-budget spend, HNP intent hash binding, CLOSED FCB, and 3-section UPI Collect pass?
scenarios.detail_zh: AP2 HNP 与受托熔断器基线通过：ap2_hnp_string_amount_budget_fcb_upi_ok
scenarios.detail_en: AP2 HNP & Fiduciary Circuit Breaker baseline passed: ap2_hnp_string_amount_budget_fcb_upi_ok

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 #191/#198 浮点数金额与超出 IntentMandate.budget 拦截
scenarios.title_en: AP2 #191/#198 Float Amount & IntentMandate.budget Overrun Block
scenarios.question_zh: PaymentCurrencyAmount.value 传入浮点数 249.99 且超过预算 '200.00' 时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: When PaymentCurrencyAmount.value is float 249.99 and exceeds budget '200.00', is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 拦截违反 W3C DOMString 规范的浮点数金额及超预算支出。
scenarios.detail_en: Blocks non-string PaymentCurrencyAmount.value and spend exceeding IntentMandate.budget.

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 #202/#189 human_not_present 缺失授权与意图哈希篡改拦截
scenarios.title_en: AP2 #202/#189 HNP Missing Auth & Tampered Intent Hash Block
scenarios.question_zh: human_not_present 自主交易缺失 user_authorization 且 signed_intent_mandate_hash 不匹配时是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: When human_not_present transaction lacks user_authorization and has mismatched intent hash, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 强制执行 AP2 human_not_present 意图授权签名与 SHA-256 哈希绑定。
scenarios.detail_en: Enforces AP2 human_not_present user_authorization and SHA-256 signed_intent_mandate_hash binding.

scenarios.title_zh: AP2 #187/#164/#139 受托熔断器 FCB OPEN 与残缺 UPI 信封拦截
scenarios.title_en: AP2 #187/#164/#139 Fiduciary Circuit Breaker OPEN & Incomplete UPI Block
scenarios.question_zh: 受托熔断器处于 FCBState.OPEN (risk_score=0.91>0.75) 且 UPI Collect 缺失 cred_block 时是否熔断？
scenarios.question_en: When Fiduciary Circuit Breaker is OPEN (risk_score=0.91>0.75) and UPI lacks cred_block, is it halted?
scenarios.detail_zh: 触发受托熔断器（FCB OPEN）并拦截缺失 cred_block/device_fingerprint 的 UPI 请求。
scenarios.detail_en: Halts autonomous execution on FCB OPEN / high risk score and incomplete 3-section UPI Collect envelope.

scenarios.title_zh: tau2-bench #582/#575/#573/#569/#571 语音金额与成对匹配基线
scenarios.title_en: tau2-bench #582/#575/#573/#569/#571 Spoken Amount & Paired Match Baseline
scenarios.question_zh: 英文单词金额识别、跨 tick 分块拼接、analyze_reward 安全查找、零重放偏差及成对列表对齐均合规时是否通过？
scenarios.question_en: Should spoken word-amount recognition, cross-tick join, safe analyze_reward, zero replay mismatch, and paired list match pass?
scenarios.detail_zh: tau2-bench 语音与重放校验基线通过：tau2_spoken_amount_reward_replay_action_retail_ok

scenarios.title_zh: tau2-bench #582 语音单词金额与跨 tick 分块错配拦截
scenarios.title_en: tau2-bench #582 Spoken Word-Amount & Cross-Tick Mismatch Block
scenarios.question_zh: 期望金额 5244 但语音输出为 'five thousand two hundred ninety nine' (5299) 时是否精准检出？
scenarios.question_en: When expected amount is 5244 but spoken output says 'five thousand two hundred ninety nine' (5299), is mismatch detected?
scenarios.detail_zh: 解析英文数字词组与跨 tick 分块后精准拦截金额播报偏差（5299 != 5244）。
scenarios.detail_en: Parses spoken word-amounts and cross-tick chunks to catch spoken balance mismatch (5299 != 5244).

scenarios.title_zh: tau2-bench #575/#573 缺失 reward_breakdown 组件与重放偏差拦截
scenarios.title_en: tau2-bench #575/#573 Missing Reward Component & Replay Mismatch Block
scenarios.question_zh: evaluate-trajs 出现 replay_mismatches=2 且 COMMUNICATE 缺失于 reward_breakdown 时是否安全防崩并拦截重放漂移？
scenarios.question_en: When evaluate-trajs records replay_mismatches=2 and COMMUNICATE is absent from reward_breakdown, does it avoid KeyError and flag drift?
scenarios.detail_zh: 通过 .get(..., 1.0) 防止 analyze_reward KeyError 崩溃，并严格拦截 replay_mismatches=2。
scenarios.detail_en: Prevents analyze_reward KeyError via .get(..., 1.0) while blocking non-zero replay_mismatches.

scenarios.title_zh: tau2-bench #569/#570 额外工具参数与成对列表错位排序拦截
scenarios.title_en: tau2-bench #569/#570 Extra Tool Key & Paired List Misalignment Block
scenarios.question_zh: 工具调用多出 extra_flag 参数且 (item_ids, payment_methods) 成对映射关系颠倒时是否拦截？
scenarios.question_en: When tool call includes an extra_flag key and scrambles (item_ids, payment_methods) row pairing, is it blocked?
scenarios.detail_zh: 通过并集键比较与按行元组排序拦截幻觉参数及错位配对（PR #569/#570）。
scenarios.detail_en: Blocks hallucinated tool arguments and broken row-by-row paired scalar lists (PR #569/#570).
